text_block_list.name: Ram
text_block_list.text:
What's the big idea? Why are you staring?
Oh, my outfit intrigues you?
Don't you have a maid at the orphanage too?
choice_data_list: It makes you look so strong.
Your outfit isn't quite like Rem's.
The maid look really suits you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうしたというのよ、
こっちをじろじろ見て。
この衣装が珍しい？
救護院にもメイド服を着た子がいたはずよ。

text_block_list.name: Ram
text_block_list.text:
\"Strong\" as a compliment for a girl? Where [i]did[/i] your life go wrong?
Still, a maid's outfit is her battle garb,
so perhaps that's exactly how I ought to look in this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
女の子に強そうだなんて、
赤ん坊から出直してくるべきね。
でも
メイド服はある意味戦闘服、
強そうに見えるくらいが
ちょうどいいのかもしれないわね。

text_block_list.name: Ram
text_block_list.text:
Oh? The design should be no different.
If you mean the chest, I won't stand for any...
Huh? Our hair ornaments? Oh. Yes. They are on different sides.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう？　
意匠は同じはずだけれど。
もし、胸のことを言っているなら浅い見識と……
え？　
髪飾りの位置？　
ああ、
そう。
確かに違うわね。

text_block_list.name: Ram
text_block_list.text:
Well, obviously.
Still, I can understand your desire to praise me.
Please, go ahead and do it some more.
text_block_list.orig_text:
当たり前じゃない。
まぁラムを褒めたくなる気持ちも分かるけれど。
さぁ、
ラムをもっと褒めたたえるがいいわ。
